description: Whole-body one-leg-at-a-time foot lift, v3: the SAME 78 s motion as whole_body_single_leg_lift_v2, re-emitted as an explicit 10 Hz tick-sampled trajectory (780 ticks, one segment) instead of v2's 25 Hz 1950-tick stream. v2 ran ok=True but came back with ticks None/None and no trace CSV; every clean run today (champion_stand_ground_hold90_10hz_v1 and friends) came from a 10 Hz tick-counted trajectory replay, so v3 puts this motion on that logging path and nothing else changes. The runner should write sysid_whole_body_single_leg_lift_v3_<ts>.csv. Motion (identical to v2, resampled by linear interpolation in time onto a uniform 780-tick grid: tick k samples v2's 1950-row 25 Hz stream at row k*1949/779, so tick 0 is bench zero and tick 779 is v2's final bench-zero row, and the whole 77.96 s plays out over 78.0 s -- a 0.08% stretch. The held poses are unaffected: the six-foot stand rows are reproduced exactly, each lift stays inside its own 7 s window, and at every one of the 780 ticks at most one leg differs from the stand pose, with yaw fixed): start at safe_zero/bench zero and stand up with champion_stand_ground_v1's stand-up ramp (rl_stand_20260812_145534.csv, 15 s, ticks 0..149); then the lift sequence (48 s, ticks 150..629): 3 s settle at the six-foot champion stand, then for each leg L0,L1,L2,L3,L4,L5 in order 1.5 s ramp lifting that foot 20 mm, 2 s hold clear, 1.5 s lower back down the same path, 2 s dwell at the full six-foot stand, then a 3 s stand lead-out; finally the same stand ramp time-reversed as a 15 s sit-down (ticks 630..779). ONLY ONE FOOT IS EVER OFF THE GROUND: the other five legs hold the stand pose exactly. The 20 mm is a VERTICAL foot displacement at constant radial reach solved with the repo's two-link IK (safe_zero.ik_hip_knee), hip ~-13.6..-14.3 deg and knee ~+1.7..+2.1 deg per leg with yaw fixed. ROBOT ON THE GROUND (unsupported), operator watching, hands ready; whole-body traj, requires force=true. Soft torque 700; loaded current budget 2.0 A with a three-consecutive-reading trip and a 3.0 A hard ceiling.
name: whole_body_single_leg_lift_v3
